analytics_collection_enabled.description: Enable Firebase Analytics collection across release targets (mobile and AppsInToss web).

crashlytics_collection_enabled.description: Enable Firebase Crashlytics collection for the mobile app.

mobile_ads_global_enabled.description: Global kill switch for ads across release targets.

cloud_save_backup_enabled.description: Enable mobile anonymous Auth and Firestore cloud-save backup after Firestore API/rules/Auth provider are ready. Local save remains authoritative.

mobile_ads_enabled_max_build_number.description: Legacy compatibility for previously built mobile apps. New builds ignore this key.

rewarded_ads_enabled.description: Legacy compatibility for previously built mobile apps. New builds ignore this key.

interstitial_ads_enabled.description: Legacy compatibility for previously built mobile apps. New builds ignore this key.

minimum_supported_version_code.description: Minimum Android versionCode allowed before showing a forced update flow.

force_update_url.description: Store URL used by a forced update flow when minimum_supported_version_code blocks the app.

remote_balance_enabled.description: Reserved flag for future remote balance tuning. Do not use as an authoritative economy control.

appsintoss_interstitial_ad_group_id.description: AppsInToss full-screen (interstitial / welcome-back return) ad group id. Empty disables the placement; set the real AppsInToss ad inventory id to go live without a redeploy.
